Page 312 reasons: list parameters directly relevant to biological BOD removal; total organic carbon, grit, grease, alkalinity, chlorides, nitrite, nitrate, potassium are said not to influence biological treatment for BOD removal; reduction of coliforms, streptococci, salmonella, protozoa, helminths and virus is incidental and not specifically designed for.
Printed BOD illustration retained separately as Ep311-1, without repairing operator grouping. Printed nutrient ratios retained as Ep312-1 and Ep312-2.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs and specified 288 dpi details; no OCR

visual_recheck.method: Distinct child actual inspection of all exact crops, full pages and enlarged details. Parent inspected diagram and T5.1 images to resolve report findings. No OCR; not independent human review.

Units g / c /d, L / c / d, mg/L and Sewage Generation 80 % of (3) match. All rows use 135 and 108. Printed missing comma in alkalinity chlorides is editorially separated in candidate summary, not a change to data. BOD illustration and nutrient ratios are accounted for separately.
